brandIdentity.designSummary:
**CivicTech Elegance: A Serene Interface for Community Waste Management**

The Vision: To create a trustworthy and efficient digital space that encourages citizen participation and streamlines municipal waste management. The design will embody the 'Elegant' style, focusing on clarity, accessibility, and a sense of calm authority. We aim to build confidence in the system through a clean, professional aesthetic that avoids any visual clutter or unnecessary distractions.

**Execution Blueprint:**
1. Symmetrical Balance: The layout will adhere to a strict symmetrical grid, ensuring a balanced and predictable user experience. This will be particularly evident in the dashboards and form layouts.
2. Whitespace as a Design Element: Generous whitespace will be used to separate content sections and highlight key elements, creating a sense of calm and order.
3. Typographic Hierarchy: A classic serif font (Cormorant Garamond) will be used for headings to convey authority and tradition, while a clean sans-serif font (Lato Light) will be used for body text to ensure readability and accessibility.
4. Muted Color Palette: The color palette will be primarily monochromatic, using shades of green, white, and blue to evoke a sense of environmental responsibility and civic duty. A subtle gold accent will be used sparingly for interactive elements.
5. Ghost Buttons and Subtle Animations: Buttons will be styled as ghost buttons (thin outlines) to maintain a clean and unobtrusive aesthetic. Animations will be subtle and slow, such as gentle fade-ins, to enhance the feeling of quality and sophistication.
brandIdentity.toneOfVoice: Professional, clear, and encouraging. The tone should inspire trust and civic engagement.

palette.paletteUsageGuide: Primary color is used for main actions and highlights. Secondary color is used for supporting actions. Background is a light gray to provide contrast. Foreground is a dark gray for readability.
palette.paletteAccessibilityNotes: Ensure sufficient contrast between text and background colors for readability. Use colorblindness simulators to verify accessibility.

headings.headingsUsageGuide: Use for all main titles and section headings. Maintain a clear hierarchy with different sizes for different levels of headings.
headings.headingsAccessibilityNotes: Ensure sufficient contrast with the background. Use semantic heading tags (H1-H6) for proper structure.

paragraphs.paragraphsUsageGuide: Use for all body text and descriptions. Ensure readability with appropriate line height and letter spacing.
paragraphs.paragraphsAccessibilityNotes: Use a font size that is easy to read. Avoid large blocks of text without visual breaks.

spacing.gaps: Base unit: 8px. All grid gaps are 24px (3x base unit).

Composition (Tailwind Spec): Full-screen container (h-screen grid place-items-center). Headline 'Smart Community Waste Management & Reporting System' (text-center text-6xl font-bold text-white). A subtle tagline below the headline (text-center text-lg text-gray-200 mt-4).

brandIdentity.designSummary: This brand design embraces a modern, minimalistic aesthetic characterized by a high-contrast black and white base palette punctuated by a vivid neon yellow accent. The layout is grid-based and modular, providing clear content separation and generous white space that enhances readability and visual hierarchy. Typography plays a central role, featuring bold, geometric sans-serif fonts with a clean and slightly technical feel, used in large uppercase headings and medium-weight body text. The neon yellow accent color is strategically applied to navigation backgrounds, call-to-action blocks, and highlighted sections, creating energetic focal points without overwhelming the design. UI components are minimal and functional, with simple black text and icons ensuring clarity and accessibility. Overall, the design conveys professionalism, modernity, and creative vibrancy, suitable for contemporary cultural institutions or brands seeking a bold yet clean visual identity.
brandIdentity.toneOfVoice: Bold, modern, professional, and creative with a clear and confident personality.

palette.paletteUsageGuide: Use the 'primary' color predominantly for text, icons, and key UI elements on light backgrounds to ensure maximum readability. The 'secondary' color serves as the main background, providing a clean and open canvas. The 'neonAccent' color is reserved for highlighting important interactive elements such as navigation bars, call-to-action blocks, and featured content backgrounds, always paired with 'primary' for text to maintain strong contrast. Avoid using 'neonAccent' for text to preserve legibility. The 'primaryForeground' and 'secondaryForeground' colors ensure text and icons stand out clearly against their respective backgrounds. This palette balances high contrast with vibrant energy, supporting accessibility and user engagement.
palette.paletteAccessibilityNotes: The combination of 'primary' text on 'secondary' background meets WCAG AA and AAA contrast standards for normal and large text. The 'neonAccent' background with 'primary' text also meets WCAG AA contrast requirements, ensuring readability for call-to-action areas. Black text on white background and vice versa provide optimal contrast. Care should be taken to avoid using 'neonAccent' for small text or low contrast elements to maintain accessibility compliance.

headings.headingsUsageGuide: Use the heading font in uppercase or sentence case with large sizes to create a commanding presence. Pair headings with the paragraph font to maintain readability and balance. Maintain ample spacing around headings to enhance clarity. Use 'primary' color for headings on light backgrounds and 'primaryForeground' on dark backgrounds. Avoid using the neonAccent color for headings to preserve legibility.
headings.headingsAccessibilityNotes: Headings in 'primary' color on 'secondary' background meet WCAG AA and AAA contrast standards. Large font sizes further improve accessibility.

paragraphs.paragraphsUsageGuide: Use the paragraph font for body text, captions, and smaller UI elements. Maintain consistent line height and letter spacing for readability. Use 'primary' color for text on 'secondary' backgrounds and 'primaryForeground' on dark backgrounds. Avoid using neonAccent for body text to ensure contrast and legibility.
paragraphs.paragraphsAccessibilityNotes: Body text in 'primary' color on 'secondary' background meets WCAG AA contrast standards for normal text sizes. Larger text sizes meet AAA standards.

welcomeSectionTypography.implementation: The welcome section uses large, bold headings anchored in the top third of the viewport, creating immediate visual impact. The text is left-aligned with generous white space around it, emphasizing clarity and focus. The neonAccent color is used as a background highlight behind key calls to action, contrasting with black text for readability. This placement draws the user's eye naturally from the top navigation down into the content.

components.containers: Containers use white or neonAccent backgrounds with clear boundaries defined by spacing rather than borders. They maintain consistent padding and margin to separate content blocks, supporting a modular and clean layout. The neonAccent container backgrounds highlight featured content or calls to action, always paired with black text for contrast.
components.images: Images are presented in clean rectangular frames with no borders or shadows, maintaining a minimal and modern look. They are spaced generously from text and other elements to avoid clutter and maintain visual balance.
components.buttons: Buttons are minimal and functional, typically black with white text or white with black text depending on background context. The 'Get tickets' button uses a black background with white text for prominence. Links are often underlined black text on white or neonAccent backgrounds, maintaining clarity and accessibility.

graphicElements.icons: Icons are simple, monochromatic black line or solid shapes consistent with the minimalistic style. They are used sparingly in navigation and UI controls to support usability without visual clutter.
graphicElements.illustrations: No decorative illustrations are present; the design relies on photography and abstract art images for visual interest.
graphicElements.stickers: No sticker or badge style elements are used; emphasis is created through color blocks and typography.

brandIdentity.designSummary: This design features a minimalist and editorial aesthetic with a strong emphasis on typography and spatial balance. The layout uses a clean two-column grid with asymmetrical splits, combining large, elegant serif headings with simple sans-serif body text. The color palette is restrained, dominated by white backgrounds and black text, complemented by a muted olive custom accent for grounding elements like the footer. Generous white space and subtle dividing lines create a spacious, airy feel. Navigation and UI elements are minimal and understated, supporting a focus on content clarity and refined presentation. Overall, the design conveys a timeless, luxurious, and professional brand identity suitable for creative and design-focused industries.
brandIdentity.toneOfVoice: Sophisticated, refined, professional, and elegant with a calm and editorial personality.

palette.paletteUsageGuide: Use the 'primary' color predominantly for all main text elements, including headings, project titles, and navigation text on light backgrounds. The 'secondary' color serves as the base background, providing a clean and spacious canvas. The 'secondaryForeground' color is used for text on the 'secondary' background, ensuring high readability. The 'footerBackground' custom color is reserved for footer backgrounds, creating a warm, grounded contrast to the white page backgrounds. Text and links within the footer should use 'primaryForeground' to maintain legibility. This palette supports a high-contrast, elegant look with minimal color distractions, emphasizing typography and layout. Avoid using colors from content images to maintain brand consistency and clarity.
palette.paletteAccessibilityNotes: The 'primary' black (#000000) on 'secondary' white (#FFFFFF) background achieves excellent WCAG AAA contrast ratios for all text sizes, ensuring maximum readability. The 'primaryForeground' white (#FFFFFF) on 'footerBackground' (#7A6F4E) provides sufficient contrast to meet WCAG AA standards for body text and links. The palette's high contrast between text and backgrounds supports accessibility and legibility across devices and lighting conditions.

headings.headingsUsageGuide: Use the 'playfair display' font for all major headings and project titles to convey sophistication and elegance. Pair with a clean sans-serif for body text to maintain readability and modernity. Maintain generous letter spacing and line height to enhance clarity and preserve the editorial tone. Headings should be black ('primary') on white ('secondary') backgrounds for maximum contrast. Avoid using the heading font for small text or body copy to prevent legibility issues.
headings.headingsAccessibilityNotes: Headings in 'playfair display' on 'secondary' white background with 'primary' black text meet WCAG AAA contrast standards, ensuring clear readability even at large sizes.

paragraphs.paragraphsUsageGuide: Use 'open sans' for all body text, navigation links, and footer content to provide a clean and legible reading experience. Combine with 'playfair display' headings for a balanced typographic hierarchy. Maintain consistent font sizes and line heights to ensure comfortable reading. Text color should be 'primary' black on 'secondary' white backgrounds, and 'primaryForeground' white on 'footerBackground' for footer text. Avoid using the body font for large display text to preserve the editorial style.
paragraphs.paragraphsAccessibilityNotes: Body text in 'open sans' with 'primary' black on 'secondary' white background meets WCAG AAA contrast requirements, supporting accessibility for all users.

welcomeSectionTypography.implementation: The welcome section uses a vertical split layout with large, vertically stacked typography on the left side, balanced by a large image on the right. The heading text is oversized and vertically aligned to create a strong visual spine that anchors the design. This placement emphasizes the brand name and core message with maximum impact, while the image provides contextual warmth and interest. The typography is carefully spaced with generous line height and letter spacing to maintain elegance and readability.

components.containers: Containers are clean and minimal with no visible borders or shadows, relying on white space and grid alignment to separate content areas. The footer container uses a solid 'footerBackground' color to visually anchor the page.
components.images: Images are large, high-quality, and used as focal points, often occupying half the screen width in split layouts. They have no borders or overlays, maintaining a natural and warm aesthetic that complements the minimal design.
components.buttons: Buttons are minimal or absent in the screenshots; if used, they should be understated with simple outlines or solid fills in 'primary' black or 'footerBackground' colors, maintaining the refined aesthetic.

graphicElements.icons: Icons are minimal and functional, such as the simple hamburger menu icon composed of three horizontal lines in 'primary' black, supporting the clean design without distraction.
graphicElements.illustrations: No illustrations are present, reinforcing the minimalist and professional tone.
graphicElements.stickers: No stickers or badges are used, maintaining a clean and uncluttered interface.

brandIdentity.designSummary: This brand design embraces a minimalistic and modern editorial style, characterized by a restrained and professional color palette dominated by soft neutrals and muted pastels. The primary background is a very light grayish-white, complemented by subtle light blue content blocks that create visual separation without overwhelming the user. Typography is elegant and classic, featuring serif fonts for headings that convey sophistication and trustworthiness, paired with clean, readable serif or serif-inspired body text. The layout employs a balanced two-column grid with generous white space, ensuring clarity and ease of navigation. Abstract geometric dot-matrix style graphics subtly reinforce the AI and technology theme, integrated as understated visual motifs. UI elements such as navigation and buttons are minimal and refined, using thin lines and subtle contrasts to maintain the airy and professional aesthetic. Overall, the design communicates a calm, authoritative, and approachable tone suitable for professional consulting and technology sectors.
brandIdentity.toneOfVoice: Professional, calm, authoritative, and approachable with a sophisticated and trustworthy personality.

palette.paletteUsageGuide: Use the 'background' color as the main page canvas to maintain a clean and open feel. The 'secondary' color is ideal for large content blocks or sections to create subtle visual separation without heavy contrast. The 'primary' color should be used for accent backgrounds or highlight areas, such as side panels or feature blocks, to add calm emphasis. Text should primarily use 'darkText' for maximum readability on all backgrounds. Buttons and interactive elements should use 'buttonBorder' for outlines and text to maintain a minimal and refined look. The 'contentBlockBackground' can be used for subtle backgrounds behind text or graphics to enhance hierarchy and focus. Combining 'primary' with 'primaryForeground' ensures accessible contrast for headings or callouts, while 'secondary' with 'secondaryForeground' supports body text and secondary content. Overall, colors are balanced to maintain a professional and approachable atmosphere with sufficient contrast for accessibility.
palette.paletteAccessibilityNotes: The 'primary' color paired with 'primaryForeground' meets WCAG AA standards for large text and UI elements, ensuring readability and accessibility. The 'secondary' color with 'secondaryForeground' also meets WCAG AA contrast ratios for body text and secondary content. The 'darkText' color on 'background' and 'secondary' backgrounds provides strong contrast for all text elements. Button borders and text using 'buttonBorder' on 'secondary' or 'background' maintain clear visibility and interactive affordance. Overall, the palette supports accessible typography and UI components across the site.

headings.headingsUsageGuide: Use the 'bitter' font for all primary headings to establish a clear hierarchy and refined tone. Headings should be sized prominently with ample line height and letter spacing to enhance readability and elegance. Pair headings with body text fonts that complement serif styles to maintain visual harmony. Use the 'primary' or 'darkText' colors for headings to ensure strong contrast against backgrounds. Avoid overly tight letter spacing to preserve the font's classic character. Headings can be spaced generously from body text to create a balanced and airy layout.
headings.headingsAccessibilityNotes: Headings in 'bitter' font with 'primaryForeground' or 'darkText' colors on 'primary' or 'background' colors meet WCAG AA contrast standards for all sizes, ensuring clear readability and accessibility.

paragraphs.paragraphsUsageGuide: Use the 'bitter' font for body text to maintain consistency and a professional appearance. Body text should be sized for comfortable reading with appropriate line height and letter spacing. Use 'darkText' or 'primaryForeground' colors for body text on 'secondary' or 'background' colors to ensure legibility. Maintain sufficient spacing between paragraphs and other elements to avoid clutter. Pair body text with serif headings for a cohesive editorial style. Avoid using body text in all caps or overly decorative styles to preserve clarity.
paragraphs.paragraphsAccessibilityNotes: Body text in 'bitter' font with 'darkText' or 'primaryForeground' colors on 'secondary' or 'background' colors meets WCAG AA contrast requirements for normal and large text, supporting accessibility.

welcomeSectionTypography.implementation: The welcome section uses a weighted quadrant layout where the left quadrant is dedicated to large, bold heading text aligned top-left, creating a strong visual anchor. The right quadrant features an abstract geometric graphic that balances the composition. This asymmetrical but balanced placement draws the eye naturally from text to image, emphasizing the message while maintaining visual interest. Generous white space surrounds the elements, enhancing clarity and focus. Typography here is large and prominent, using the 'bitter' font for headings with ample line height and letter spacing to convey authority and sophistication.

grid.compositionApproach: Two-column grid with alternating content blocks

components.containers: Containers use subtle background color blocks such as 'primary' and 'secondary' to visually separate content areas. They maintain generous padding and margin to ensure content clarity and breathing room. Borders are minimal or absent, relying on color contrast for separation.
components.images: Images or graphics are treated as abstract geometric dot-matrix style shapes with monochromatic or muted pastel colors. They integrate seamlessly into the layout as side or background elements, maintaining the minimal and professional aesthetic.
components.buttons: Buttons are minimal with thin borders using 'buttonBorder' color and transparent backgrounds. Text inside buttons uses 'darkText' for readability. Hover states may invert colors subtly or increase border weight to indicate interactivity without disrupting the clean design.

graphicElements.icons: Icons are minimal line-based designs in 'darkText' or 'buttonBorder' colors, consistent with the overall minimal and professional style.
graphicElements.illustrations: Illustrations are abstract, geometric, and pixelated or dot-matrix style, using monochromatic or muted pastel colors to reinforce the AI and technology theme subtly.
graphicElements.stickers: No stickers or badges are present; the design avoids decorative elements to maintain a clean and professional look.

initialPrompt:
Create a modern, responsive full-stack ready website for a project called “Smart Community Waste Management & Reporting System”.

Target users:
1) Citizens
2) Municipal Admins

Design requirements:
- Clean, professional, civic-tech style
- Green, white, and blue color palette
- Mobile-first responsive design
- Simple navigation and clear call-to-action buttons

Pages to generate:

1) Home Page
- Project title and short tagline about improving urban cleanliness
- “Report Garbage Issue” call-to-action button
- Section explaining how the system works (Report → Track → Resolve)
- Benefits for citizens and municipalities

2) Citizen Authentication Pages
- Login page
- Signup page
- Form-based layout with email and password fields
- Keep backend logic placeholder-ready for Supabase authentication

3) Citizen Dashboard
- Form to submit a waste complaint with:
  - Image upload placeholder
  - Text description field
  - Location input placeholder
- Button to submit report
- Table or card list showing:
  - User’s submitted complaints
  - Complaint status (Pending / In Progress / Resolved)
  - Date and time of submission

4) Admin Login Page
- Separate admin login interface
- Clearly indicate “Authorized Access Only”

5) Admin Dashboard
- Overview cards:
  - Total complaints
  - Pending complaints
  - Resolved complaints
- Complaints management table showing:
  - Complaint ID
  - Location
  - Status
  - Assigned worker
- Buttons to:
  - Assign complaint
  - Update complaint status

6) Analytics Page (Admin Only)
- Placeholder charts for:
  - Complaints frequency over time
  - Resolution time analysis
  - Area-wise complaint distribution
- Graphs should be frontend-ready (data will come from Supabase later)

7) About Page
- Explain the problem of poor waste management
- Describe how this system improves accountability and cleanliness

Technical notes:
- Do NOT implement backend logic yet
- Keep all forms, dashboards, and charts ready for Supabase integration
- Use reusable components and clean layout
- Ensure admin and citizen sections are clearly separated
